title: Thai-Indian Cabbage Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy curry made with cabbage, inspired by the blend of Thai and Indian cuisines.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add shredded cabbage and cook until it starts to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add curry powder, salt, and 1 cup of water. Stir well.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the cabbage is tender, about 10-12 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and continue to simmer for another 2-3 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
